name: Principality of Seborga
description: A white field; the fly half bears nine horizontal blue stripes, and at the hoist a crowned shield charged with a blue cross.
history: Flag of the Principality of Seborga, the Ligurian village that has claimed independence from Italy since Giorgio Carbone's movement began in 1963, arguing the village was never properly annexed by the modern Italian state.

features.role: blue-and-white stripes on the fly half
crowned shield with a blue cross
